create_Trainer: create a Trainer instance with a generator, discriminator, optimizers, gan_type, reg_type, and reg_param
run_generator_trainstep: run a generator training step by calling generator_trainstep with label y and latent z tensors
run_discriminator_trainstep: run a discriminator training step by calling discriminator_trainstep with real data x, label y, and latent z
use_toggle_grad: use toggle_grad to enable or disable gradient computation for all parameters of a PyTorch model
use_update_average: use update_average to perform exponential moving average of source model parameters into a target model with beta
